rows.label: Earth
rows.description: third planet from the Sun in the Solar System
rows.hook: is the only world known to harbor life and is mostly covered by ocean

rows.label: Sun
rows.description: star at the centre of the Solar System
rows.hook: is the hot ball of plasma that gives our planets light and warmth

rows.label: Colosseum
rows.description: ancient Roman amphitheatre, a landmark of Rome, Italy
rows.hook: is the largest ancient amphitheatre ever built, begun under Emperor Vespasian

rows.label: Milky Way
rows.description: galaxy containing our Solar System
rows.hook: is the home galaxy whose hazy band of light stretches across the night sky

rows.label: Stonehenge
rows.description: Neolithic henge monument in Amesbury, Wiltshire, England, UK
rows.hook: is a prehistoric ring of giant standing stones on an English plain

rows.label: Leaning Tower of Pisa
rows.description: cathedral bell tower in Pisa, Italy
rows.hook: is a famous cathedral bell structure that tilts nearly four degrees on an unstable foundation

rows.label: Rubik's Cube
rows.description: 3-D combination puzzle with many different permutations
rows.hook: is a twisty puzzle invented by a Hungarian architecture professor in the 1970s

rows.label: rainbow
rows.description: meteorological phenomenon caused by reflection, refraction and dispersion of light in water droplets
rows.hook: is a multicoloured band of light that appears when sunshine meets rain

rows.label: Washington Monument
rows.description: obelisk on the National Mall in Washington, D.C.
rows.hook: is a tall stone landmark honoring the first U.S. president

rows.label: Giant's Causeway
rows.description: rock formation on the Antrim coast of Northern Ireland
rows.hook: is a coastal landmark of about 40,000 interlocking basalt columns left by an ancient eruption

rows.label: snail
rows.description: common name for shelled Gastropods
rows.hook: is a slow-moving mollusc that carries a coiled shell on its back

rows.label: bagel
rows.description: torus-shaped bread product
rows.hook: is a dense, chewy bread roll that is boiled briefly before it is baked

rows.label: doughnut
rows.description: dessert food
rows.hook: is a sweet fried or baked treat made from leavened dough, found in bakeries everywhere

rows.label: pretzel
rows.description: German baked pastry shaped into a knot
rows.hook: is a baked, salted pastry twisted from a long strip of dough, popular as a snack

rows.label: Pringles
rows.description: brand of potato-based chips
rows.hook: is a stackable potato-based snack chip invented by Procter & Gamble

rows.label: dice
rows.description: throwable object (usually but not necessarily a cube) with multiple resting positions, used for generating random integers or outcomes
rows.hook: are small tossed objects with marked sides, used for chance in board games and tabletop adventures

rows.label: Toblerone
rows.description: brand of chocolate confection
rows.hook: is a Swiss chocolate brand, long made only in Bern

rows.label: flag of Nepal
rows.description: national flag of the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal
rows.hook: is the only national banner that is taller than it is wide, built from two pennants

rows.label: United States one-dollar bill
rows.description: current denomination of United States currency
rows.hook: is the lowest-value paper money in the U.S., showing the first president

rows.label: association football pitch
rows.description: rectangular area where association football is played
rows.hook: is the playing surface defined by Law 1 of the Laws of the Game

rows.label: phonograph record
rows.description: analog sound storage medium in the form of a flat disc with an inscribed, modulated spiral groove
rows.hook: is the analog music medium with a groove that a needle follows to play sound

rows.label: flag of Switzerland
rows.description: national flag of the Swiss Confederation
rows.hook: is a white cross on a red field, unusual for not being oblong

rows.label: basketball
rows.description: inflated ball used for basketball games
rows.hook: is the inflated ball bounced, passed and shot through hoops

rows.label: Death Star
rows.description: fictional space station used as a superweapon by the Galactic Empire in the Star Wars universe
rows.hook: is the moon-sized space station and planet-destroying superweapon of an evil Empire
